segments.text: スフィーと同じくグエンディーナからやってきた女の子。
スフィーの妹だが、姉よりよほどしっかりしている。
言葉遣いは丁寧で、非常に姉思い。
自分に対して自信がなく、引っ込み思案なところも。
スフィーと同じくグエンディーナからやってきた女の子。 スフィーの妹だが、姉よりよほどしっかりしている。 言葉遣いは丁寧で、非常に姉思い。 自分に対して自信がなく、引っ込み思案なところも。

An unfriendly young man with a bit of a temper. While he gets along to a degree with his best friend, Isao, Kida is something of a loner during his time off. He has no real interest in relationships, or "normal" life in general, and because of this he believes that the world would probably be better off without him. Despite being someone who lacks direction, he will be quick to act when the situation calls for it. His only real source of comfort is smoking cigarettes.
Edited from Wikipedia

Kida's classmate. A simple girl that is seen as troublesome by most and a true nuisance by Kida. Despite knowing that she is slow and somewhat bothersome to others, Touko feels she needs to do her best and contribute to the world. Unfortunately, the fact that Touko has never had a chance to prove herself has left her with a desire to find something that will give her own life some meaning. She manages to find that meaning upon meeting Kida, and will do anything to preserve it.
Edited from Wikipedia

Aruruu is Eruruu's shy, quiet younger sister, and a friend to Yuzuha and Camyu. Like Eruruu, she is also named after a fictional flower. It is said that the Eruruu and Aruruu flowers only grow together. When she first meets Hakuoro she is shy, running and hiding from Hakuoro at every opportunity and speaking very little. After Hakuoro eventually wins over Aruruu's affections, she calls Hakuoro "father".
Based on Wikipedia

Aruruu raises Mutikapa's baby tiger, naming it Mukkuru. After it grows (in an astoundingly short period of time), she begins to ride him into battle, often in spite of orders or warnings to stay away from danger

It is later revealed that Aruruu had been severely injured presumably from an earthquake prior to meeting Hakuoro. Uitsualnemetia healed her in exchange for Eruruu's body and soul. She is also heavily wounded and presumably killed by an attack from Hauenkua, but is revived by Hakuoro in his aspect as Uitsualnemetia
Prototype of robot who can show abundant emotions. Is going to school as a test. Likes to clean and being helpful to humans in general.

Reserved and isolated from the rest of her class, the cause is rumors going around since she was in middle school about poltergeists and strange phenomena happening around her. Apparently she also has some kind of precognition.
Has liked the protagonist since the previous year, and suddenly confesses to him. Because of family circumstances engages in a number of part-time works. Worries very much about her little brother.
Developed and tested alongside Multi, instead of having a variety of emotions Serio can access and download data from a satellite, having thus available a wide range of skills.
After the death of his father, who was in charge of his cousins and living with them, he is now staying with them for a while after not seeing them since he was little.

Second of the Kashiwagi sisters. Energetic and athletic, has a tomboy-ish personality but also a surprising housekeeping side, being very talented at cooking and cleaning. Member of the track and field club at her school.
Youngest of the Kashiwagi sisters. Treats Kouichi as a big brother. Cheerful and friendly, has an outstanding visual memory.
Member of the volleyball club, saw a mysterious group at night.
Secretary of the student council. Has been a close friend of Kanako since middle school.
School idol until about one year before, when she suddenly became very strange and aloof. Seems to have some interest in Yuusuke.
Vicepresident of the student council. Very popular and with good grades, suddenly became mad in the middle of classes.

segments.text: Stays with the protagonist after killing and then revive him. Due to the large amount of magic used, her body size shrunk dramatically.
The younger sister of Tokinori.
Despite being the younger of the two, Emiri is undoubtedly the more dominant and, in some ways, has seized control of the household.
Despite their disagreements, Emiri still has a strong bond with her brother. She has learned to lower her expectations of him due to his lack of direction.
She also respects and admires Yukio.
Edited from Wikipedia

Mizuki Takase is the protagonist's friend since junior high and eventually end up in the same college together. She is energetic and athletic with long red hair in a side ponytail. She's hostile and skeptical towards otaku and doujinshi, and is initially opposed to Kazuki's new activity. However, she's also torn by Kazuki's expressions of satisfaction with the doujinshi process, and worries that it leaves less time for them together.
From AniDB

Inagawa Yuu is a Kansai-speaking, passionate doujinshi enthusiast. She is from Kobe, but comes to Tokyo often for Comic Party. Her parents own a Japanese inn and hot-springs resort that she will inherit when she is older. Yuu is the sole member of the circle "Karamitei". She teaches Kazuki about doujinshi publishing and comics exhibition. She is nicknamed "Hot springs Panda" (Panda Onseniko) by Eimi because she owns a hot springs and she has large circle glasses that is similar to the dark patches around the panda's eyes.
From AniDB

Miko fighter obsessed with hero stories, but terrible at creating doujinshi. Her group is "Sin-jushokakutei." She is not featured in the original game, only in the games that were made for Dreamcast and PSP.
From AniDB

The other half of "Brother 2", he is a typical otaku who sees the doujinshi concept as the leading pop-culture format of the 21st century. Grandiose in the expressions of his dreams, he takes charge of the logistical aspects of the partnership (paying registration fees, arranging printers, etc.), leaving the actual artwork to Kazuki.
From AniDB
